title: Page Visual v1
description: The vision pass over one rendered PDF page: a caption, how much of it is readable, what is uncertain, and the directly-readable observations. Only the model's own words are declared here — paperHash, page, figureId, attachmentSha256, model, route, source and needsUserReview are stamped by the platform in src/knowledge/visual.ts and must never be model-claimed, so they are not required (and extra properties are accepted, which is also what lets the same name validate the stored record). What is NOT checked: that no value was estimated from pixels, that the caption matches the page, or that confidence reflects readability rather than importance — and no numeric conclusion belongs to this contract at all. The prompt's "(non-empty)" wording is deliberately not written as minLength: the text-fallback path stores an empty caption on purpose when a page has no readable text, and a schema that rejected it would abort a run that is honestly reporting that it saw nothing.

confidence.description: How much of the caption is directly readable; the platform derives needsUserReview from it, so the stated 0..1 range is the one numeric bound worth keeping.
